Triple Take is a fast-paced 2D precision platformer where the stage evolves as you complete it. Run, wall jump, climb, and swim your way through increasingly difficult levels in vibrant colored worlds.

But beware, the game is not for the faint of heart. With challenging obstacles and enemies at every turn, you'll need quick reflexes and precision to make it to the end.

Triple Take's unique gameplay mechanics and evolving stages will keep you on your toes and engaged from start to finish. You'll never know what's coming next as the stage shifts and changes before your very eyes.

Don't miss out on this incredible deal! Download Triple Take now at 40% off during the Steam Spring Sale and experience the platformer excitement for yourself.

notes.title: Triple Take Forever Money Distribution Patch
notes.content:
Hi folks, We've updated the distribution of money in endless mode to make some of the grindy achievements a tad less grindy. The amount of money given per stage now increases with a streak up to 10, so beating the first level in a run still awards one coin, but the tenth one gives 10 coins, and the seventeenth still gives just 10. 

Thanks for the feedback on the mode! We hope you continue to enjoy Triple Take!

notes.title: Triple Take Forever Patch
notes.content: Sorry folks! Looks like we left a bug in the game that caused a crash when dying on any regular level! This has been fixed now, sorry for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Triple Take is Officially Released
notes.content:
[i]You are always on the lookout for the perfect ways to spend some time with challenging but fun little games. We're happy to let you know you can fill in that gap in your soul now. Triple Take is out on Steam today, on October 6th with a price of 6.99 USD/EUR and a 20% discount.
[/i]
Triple Take is simple but yet cute and amusing in its visual style. You play in a (un)vibrantly coloured world inside of your computer which in cursed by an entity trying to corrupt the whole game! You must complete the levels in order to beat the entity and save the game.

But wait! The entity makes you play each level three times, and it keeps making the level harder and harder with each try!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41119595/b59f56b0bcc296bcc8148dfcf8e7e2340df88938.gif[/img]

[b]The main features of the game:
[/b]
[list]
[*] The game breaks the fourth wall: an entity corrupts the game, and you must complete tasks on your computer AND beat each level three times as it evolves making your task harder and harder
[*] Simple yet amusing and cute art style, soundtrack, and story keep you entertained for the whole over 50 levels
[*] Puzzles, precision, skills, challenges, wall jumps, traps... What else would you need!
[*] Triple Take is out now, on October 6th on Steam with a price of 6.99 USD/EUR and a 20% release discount, so get it now.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=in-v3bj_PfU;full][/previewyoutube]

Triple Take on Steam: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1734250/Triple_Take/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1734250/Triple_Take/[/url]

Press and media kit available here: [url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1taisPXf2klTbkJSABaq3KP07XqUkYkCb]https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1taisPXf2klTbkJSABaq3KP07XqUkYkCb[/url]

notes.title: Triple Take coming to Steam on October 6th.
notes.content:
Yes, we have a date! Triple Take coming to Steam on October 6th. 

[previewyoutube=in-v3bj_PfU;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

When you start any level for the first time, it might seem to be almost too easy to beat, but the levels evolve when you play further. Every time you beat any level, the level changes somehow and you need to play it again. Three times. Triple Take. Ok, you got it. This makes completing levels… difficult. Jumps become more difficult, new threats reveal themselves, and new pathways open up! Difficult.

“Triple Take introduces some really surprising game design ideas that left us stunned at first sight”, an anonymous person from Bonus Stage Publishing states, and continues: “Oh, and I need to add that speedrunning this game will be absolutely hilarious to watch.”

Discover the real truth of the game. But be careful, it might not be happy to be discovered. Oh, and this is also a horror game. I almost forgot to mention that.
